identity.name: SMB Traffic from Non-Standard Process
identity.summary: An attacker uses a non-standard process to initiate SMB traffic, bypassing typical security controls. Cortex should detect this behavior as an anomaly in process-to-SMB network connections.
identity.description: An attacker uses a non-standard process to initiate SMB traffic, bypassing typical security controls. Cortex should detect this behavior as an anomaly in process-to-SMB network connections.

expected_artifacts.description: SMB traffic initiated from non-standard process

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: SMB Traffic from Non-Standard Process
biocs.description: Detects SMB network connections originating from non-standard processes such as wget or custom binaries
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.50'
| filter dst_port = 445
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'svchost.exe' and actor_process_image_name != 'lsass.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'

abiocs.name: Unusual SMB Connection from Custom Binary
abiocs.description: Detects SMB traffic initiated by a binary not typically associated with SMB operations
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.50'
| filter dst_port = 445
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'svchost.exe' and actor_process_image_name != 'lsass.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name contains '/tmp/'
